description: This file defines an authentication service for a frontend application, providing functions for login, signup, logout, and retrieving stored user data. It interacts with API endpoints and manages authentication tokens via localStorage.

methods.name: login(username, password)
methods.description: Performs user login by calling the API and storing tokens and user info in localStorage.

methods.name: signup({ username, email, password })
methods.description: Registers a new user via the API and returns the created user data.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Clears stored authentication tokens and user data from localStorage.

methods.name: getStoredUser()
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the stored user object from localStorage.

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^export async function signup({ username, email, password }) {$/
